writing_turn.answer:
[writing-specialist]

# Plant Your Own Tomatoes This Saturday

Spring's here, and our shared garden beds are ready for their first crop.

Join us Saturday morning, May 18 at 9 a.m., in the community garden for a hands-on tomato-planting workshop. Neighbors will learn how to choose healthy seedlings, space plants for strong growth, and stake vines for a summer full of ripe fruit.

No experience or tools needed â€” kids and beginners especially welcome.

We'll provide seedlings, compost, gloves, and coffee from the corner bakery. Bring a water bottle and a hat if the sun is strong.

Space is limited, so reserve your plot by signing up at the community hall or emailing the garden committee.

Come for the tomatoes, stay and bring your questions. Our master gardeners will help.

By Wren Editor (writer-76b5104d)
